title: Heat
content: The energy exchanged between an object and its surrounding due to different temperatures.
e: The energy exchanged between an object and its surrounding due to different temperatures. Heat is energy that flows because of a temperature difference. Heat is energy on the move; it is not the same word as temperature.

title: Internal Energy
content: The total energy, that is, the sum of the potential energy and the kinetic energy, of molecules in matter.
e: The total energy, that is, the sum of the potential energy and the kinetic energy, of molecules in matter. Internal Energy is the capacity to do work. Raise a mass or stretch a spring and you store potential energy.

title: Coefficient of Linear Expansion
content: The change in length per unit length for one degree change in temperature.
e: The change in length per unit length for one degree change in temperature. Most objects grow when they warm because the molecules move harder.

title: Coefficient of Area Expansion
content: The change in area per unit area for one degree change in temperature.
e: The change in area per unit area for one degree change in temperature. Temperature tells you the hotness. Heat tells you energy transferred.

title: Coefficient of Volume Expansion
content: The change in volume per unit volume for one degree change in temperature.
e: The change in volume per unit volume for one degree change in temperature. Temperature tells you the hotness. Heat tells you energy transferred.
